visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The frame opens with a close-up of a hand holding a square makeup palette. The palette contains four shades of creamy concealer. The background shows a person in a pink shirt. (2) A man with short black hair and a black shirt appears alongside a woman with auburn hair in a pink shirt. They stand against a plain studio background and interact with the camera. (3) A close-up view of the woman's face focuses on skin details. A makeup brush is used as a pointer to indicate specific areas like dark circles and acne, accompanied by white arrow graphics and text. (4) A hand applies concealer to the woman's face using a small brush. The application covers the undereye area, the sides of the nose, the chin, and forehead. The lighting is bright and even. (5) Before and after comparison shots are displayed, showing the transition of the skin texture and color. Text overlays appear at the bottom. (6) The man and woman reappear together, smiling and looking at the camera. The man holds the palette as they both wave their hands in a friendly farewell gesture.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) Fast-paced electronic pop background music starts with a prominent synthesized beat. A male voice speaks enthusiastically and rapidly, introducing a product. (2) Multiple sharp 'ding' sound effects trigger in rapid succession as the male voice lists specific skin terms. The music remains consistently upbeat in the background. (3) The male voice transitions into a clear, instructive narrative tone, explaining a multi-step process. A female voice occasionally laughs or adds short cheerful comments. (4) The tempo of the BGM feels more energetic. Both male and female voices engage in a loud, positive back-and-forth dialogue. The session concludes with warm, high-arousal farewells from both voices as the music reaches its peak.
